notifications: Nta butumwa buri muri iri gerageza kugeza ubu.

help.label: Ubufasha
help.title: Ibyerekeye iri gerageza
help.body: Uru rubuga ni igerageza rikoresha amakuru y'abarwayi atari ay'ukuri. Ntirukoreshwa mu buvuzi. Ibimenyetso by'amategeko biva ku mategeko y'igerageza atemejwe mu buvuzi.
help.roles: Abakozi b'igerageza berekana icyo buri ruhare rushobora gukora. Guhindura umukozi ni igerageza gusa — si ukwinjira mu buryo bwemewe.
help.tools: Koresha Ibikoresho by'igerageza hejuru kugira ngo usubize amakuru uko yari ari, ufungure urugero cyangwa wigane ibibazo by'umuyoboro.
